definitions.gloss: acne scar; pimple mark; blemish from acne
definitions.explanation: A mark, discoloration, or indentation left on the skin after acne has healed. A common concern discussed in skincare and dermatology contexts.

examples.japanese: ニキビ{跡|あと}が{残|のこ}ってしまった。
examples.english: I ended up with acne scars.

examples.japanese: ニキビ{跡|あと}を{消|け}すクリームを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a cream to remove acne scars.

examples.japanese: ニキビ{跡|あと}がなかなか{消|き}えないので、{皮膚科|ひふか}で{相談|そうだん}することにした。
examples.english: Since the acne scars wouldn't go away, I decided to consult a dermatologist.

notes:
Composed of ニキビ (acne, pimple) + {跡|あと} (mark, trace). A very common concern for young people in Japan, frequently discussed on skincare websites, beauty forums, and in dermatology clinics.

Types of ニキビ{跡|あと} include {赤|あか}み (redness), {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく} (pigmentation), and クレーター (pitted scars, from English "crater").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ニキビ{跡|あと}が{残|のこ}る: acne scars remain
- ニキビ{跡|あと}を{消|け}す: to remove acne scars
- ニキビ{跡|あと}を{治|なお}す: to treat acne scars
- ニキビ{跡|あと}ケア: acne scar care
- ニキビ{跡|あと}の{赤|あか}み: redness from acne scars

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ニキビ: acne, pimple — the active blemish itself, not the scar
- {吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの}: breakout, skin eruption — a more general or adult-sounding term for acne
- {傷跡|きずあと}: scar — a general term for any scar from injury
